package com.acme.invoicing.service;

import com.acme.invoicing.domain.Invoice;
import com.acme.invoicing.domain.InvoiceStatus;
import com.acme.invoicing.exception.InvoiceNotFoundException;
import com.acme.invoicing.repository.InvoiceRepository;
import com.acme.invoicing.util.InvoiceNumberUtils;
import com.acme.invoicing.web.dto.IssueInvoiceRequest;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

/**
 * CR-3310: invoice numbers now come from the DB sequence (was LegacyInvoiceNumberGenerator)
 * and payments may be partial.
 */
@Service
public class InvoiceServiceImpl implements InvoiceService {

    private static final String PREFIX = "INV";

    private final InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository;
    private final Clock clock;

    public InvoiceServiceImpl(final InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository, final Clock clock) {
        this.invoiceRepository = invoiceRepository;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public Invoice issue(final IssueInvoiceRequest request) {
        final LocalDate today = LocalDate.now(clock);
        final long next = invoiceRepository.currentSequence(PREFIX) + 1;
        final String number = InvoiceNumberUtils.format(PREFIX, today, next);
        final Invoice invoice = new Invoice(number, request.customerId(), request.amount(),
                today.plusDays(request.termDays() > 0 ? request.termDays() : 30));
        return invoiceRepository.save(invoice);
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Invoice findByNumber(final String invoiceNo) {
        if (!InvoiceNumberUtils.isValid(invoiceNo)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed invoice number: " + invoiceNo);
        }
        return invoiceRepository.findByInvoiceNo(invoiceNo)
                .orElseThrow(InvoiceNotFoundException::new);
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<Invoice> findOverdue(final int days) {
        return invoiceRepository.findOverdue(LocalDate.now(clock).minusDays(days));
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public Invoice recordPayment(final String invoiceNo, final BigDecimal amount) {
        final Invoice invoice = findByNumber(invoiceNo);
        if (invoice.getStatus() == InvoiceStatus.PAID || invoice.getStatus() == InvoiceStatus.VOID) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Invoice " + invoiceNo + " is " + invoice.getStatus());
        }
        if (amount == null || amount.signum() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Payment amount must be positive");
        }
        final BigDecimal outstanding = invoice.getOutstanding().subtract(amount);
        if (outstanding.signum() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Overpayment of " + outstanding.negate() + " on " + invoiceNo);
        } else if (outstanding.signum() == 0) {
            invoice.setStatus(InvoiceStatus.PAID);
        } else {
            invoice.setStatus(InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID);
        }
        invoice.setOutstanding(outstanding);
        return invoiceRepository.save(invoice);
    }
}
